findings.text: the pattern's \s+ between buckets demands a space the renderer supplies only by the following bucket's two-column padding, so a correct render whose blocked, unpromoted or queued count reaches two digits parses as no counter block at all: probed at revision 0ef7a946, counts (10,12,0,0) render as '10w12b 0u 0q' and the pattern matched nothing, where the base pattern's \s* would have matched; a fixture with ten blocked runs would red looking like a renderer defect.

the comment claims the block is matched whole so a bucket added later cannot slip past the prefix of an older count, but _COUNTERS is applied by unanchored re.search at line 122 and the pattern carries no trailing boundary, so a fifth cell appended to the block leaves the four-cell match intact and the new bucket unasserted; anchor the whole run or drop the claim.

the tests entries for the head arm, the id-list arm and the base arm carry an unsubstituted placeholder in place of the command that ran, so the manifest's gate-command field names no runnable command and a reader must open the named log to recover it.
